gloss: to reflect, to project, to show on screen

definitions.explanation: To cause an image to appear on a reflective surface such as a mirror or water.

definitions.gloss: to project, to show on screen
definitions.explanation: To display images or video on a screen, projector, monitor, or similar device.

examples.japanese: {鏡|かがみ}に{顔|かお}を{映|うつ}した。
examples.english: I looked at my face in the mirror.

examples.japanese: {湖|みずうみ}が{山|やま}の{姿|すがた}を{美|うつく}しく{映|うつ}していた。
examples.english: The lake beautifully reflected the mountains.

examples.japanese: {水面|すいめん}に{映|うつ}された{夕焼|ゆうや}けが{幻想的|げんそうてき}だった。
examples.english: The sunset reflected on the water surface was fantastic.

examples.japanese: {写真|しゃしん}をスクリーンに{映|うつ}した。
examples.english: I projected the photos on the screen.

examples.japanese: カメラが{事故|じこ}の{瞬間|しゅんかん}を{映|うつ}していた。
examples.english: The camera had captured the moment of the accident.

examples.japanese: プロジェクターで{資料|しりょう}を{映|うつ}しながら、{説明|せつめい}を{進|すす}めた。
examples.english: I proceeded with the explanation while projecting the materials on the projector.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Intransitive pair: {映|うつ}る.

ASPECT: ている indicates an ongoing state of reflecting/projecting. {映|うつ}している = 'is reflecting/projecting.'

KANJI NOTE:
Distinguish from homophones:
- {映|うつ}す: to reflect, to project (visual image) — this entry
- {写|うつ}す: to copy, to photograph
- {移|うつ}す: to move, to transfer

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鏡|かがみ}に{映|うつ}す: to reflect in a mirror
- スクリーンに{映|うつ}す: to project onto a screen
- {姿|すがた}を{映|うつ}す: to reflect a figure/form

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {映|うつ}る: to be reflected (intransitive pair)
- {写|うつ}す: to copy, to photograph
- {投影|とうえい}する: to project (technical)
